what: THE JOIN-1 LOADOUT HOLD for the barbarian (d2-ww-barb): sword main hand (weapon_r), axe off hand (weapon_l), for idle, walk and run -- the layer list agreed with the JOIN renderer's drax (runs/C-9/join1_render/scripts/render_cells.gd reads `layers` from this path). Each layer: a filtered Blend2 over the state's clip, bottom to top, at `weight`, in `states`, its action's time by `time`: "pose" = frame 0 held; {"sync", "c_base", "c_layer"} = t_layer = fposmod(t / T_base - c_base + c_layer, 1) * T_layer (the left-toe contact phases, knight.gd _contact_phase's rule). filter_from "all_clips": every bone in `bones` is filtered, taken from any clip that keys it -- the importer DROPS a rest-valued track, and the guards key the wrist AT REST (the neutral wrist that keeps the haft in the fist's channel); a filtered bone the action lacks blends to rest, which is the intent.
author: drax (T12 lane), 2026-09-30
body_recipe: T12_10's body (eb8a3837: T12_9 + the text-to-motion loops fixed; every JOIN clip identical to T12_9's) -> nb_d2/scripts/59_offhand_mount.py (weapon_l's rest = the axe's seat in the left fist) -> nb_d2/scripts/60_pose_clips.py (the six join_guard_* clips). Nothing else differs from T12_10. v2: the six join_guard_* clips re-solved outboard (JOIN_hold_v2/join_guard_*.json).

mount.weapon_r: the T12 seat at roll 0 (unchanged; the -39 roll was an instrument error, ruled out)
mount.weapon_l: the axe's seat in the LEFT fist: the right seat mirrored across his sagittal plane, its haft turned 1.32 deg onto the left hand's own channel; the left fist centroid 0.0136 m off the haft (the right side's: 0.0109 m). The axe is the same axe, turned into the hand -- not mirrored

sockets.edges: +Z of weapon_r is the sword's edge (sword_edge marker); +Z of weapon_l is the axe's cutting edge (axe_edge marker)

morphs_note: grip_L closes the left fist on the axe haft (the shield's grip morph). helmet_on was 1 in the measurement (the helmet worn); the kit decides
design: The upper body is the Barrow's armed gait (walk_armed / run_armed on Spine02..Head, phase-mapped onto the unarmed legs) -- the same torso the game's armed walk and run show. Both arms hold a GUARD solved per state (attack_lab/tools/guard_pose_solve.py --side R/L --cells-offset 0 --azimuth 70): the haft 55 deg from vertical at idle (52.5 at walk and run, whose chests wander 6 and 10 deg), 70 deg outboard -- a symmetric X -- the grip in front at belly-to-chest height, the wrist neutral; idle solved at idle_guard's stance chest, walk and run at their mean chest with the upper layer on. The azimuth is readability's: with the renderer's octant cameras a haft at az and az + 45 reads alike, and 70 keeps the weapons apart.

measured.tool: attack_lab/t12/godot/tools/join_accept.gd (this spec, the renderer's tree, the body loaded at runtime like the renderer)
measured.reading: both weapons at guard on 100% of frames in idle, walk and run (and on the renderer's 12); 0 penetration and 0 hand contact; the weapons never nearer than 0.115 m; each weapon's worst direction keeps 30-44 px of its ~120 px (the haft seen end-on in its own weak diagonal: the sword SE/E, the axe SW/W), and in that direction the other weapon reads at 107-122 px

measure_keys_note: pieces_list, weapons, states_measured: what attack_lab/t12/godot/tools/join_accept.gd reads to re-measure this spec as it stands
v2: JOIN hold v2 (Matt, R-C9-93: 'move the axe arm further out towards his shoulder... The same goes for the other hand when holding a weapon'): the six join_guard_* poses re-solved with BOTH fists outboard -- guard_pose_solve.py with v1's arguments (--stance-key 53 --cells-offset 0 --azimuth 70; tilt 55 idle, 52.5 walk and run at their mean chests; --side L for the axe) and the grip box's outboard range raised (v1 0.12-0.32 m: the solves sat on its inner edge, 0.116-0.119): the sword 0.16-0.22, the axe 0.143-0.20 (the two hands then read alike); at the walk's and the run's twisted chests the outboard component is taken in the CHEST's frame (--box-frame chest), so the fist is off the TORSO's centreline. Same guard hafts, wrists neutral, layers, weights, filters and timing; only the six clips' keys differ. Body = v1's (b5371921) with the six clips replaced (60_pose_clips.py).

v2_fist.what: each fist's offset from his centreline over the same side's shoulder half-width, in the chest's frame (join_accept.gd FIST): the grip (the weapon bone's mount) from the chest joint, along the weapon's outboard side, over the shoulder ball joint's
